[quote=western_view;60032211][spoiler=The Discovery][b][i]Western View Paper[/i][/b]
Today at 2:12 in the morning, Wessernian time, the crew of the SFS Trilobite found a long length on debris on the ocean floor. This debris trail ended up belonging to a ship wreck, 10 miles from where the SOS was sent, the SS Leviathan rest in many pieces on the ocean floor. The SFS Trilobite's crew celebrated at first, but quickly fell silent, because 38 people died on this ship, and many aquatic animals have almost died because of the oil. In the Western View Hospital, the two survivors of the sinking are said to be released tomorrow, and that means the WVTSB (Western View Transportation Safety Bureau) has the opportunity to interview the two crew members soon. The WVIB (Western View Investigation Bureau) has come out with the results of the bomb testing, and they have come to conclude that, yes, there was a bomb on board, but now they have to figure out what kind of bomb, and who placed it there.[/spoiler]
[spoiler=The Final Verdict][i][b]Western View Paper[/b][/i]
After the WVIB (Western View Investigation Bureau) released a report on the results of the SS Leviathan debris piece, named piece 2, they came with the final verdict for the Wessernian Bridge collapse. It turns out it was a bomb, and they know who placed it, a man named Hatzur Zatsugi, the infamous leader of an Anti-Wessernian government group called the Guhui'Benardio (Juh-hoo-ben-ar-dE-O) and he was accompanied by 5 other men, Kiliwo Danf, Gerniu Jak, Ventru and Zero Dezervio, and Antio Ati. The WVIB has also requested that all bridges be closed until further notice, thus forcing many to airports and ship ports to get from one part of the island to another.[/spoiler] [spoiler=Two in One Day]The Wessern 500, is a 500 mile race, and the most popular in Wessernia, with an average of 5,000,000 dollars made by selling tickets alone. Usually around 500,000 people watch the race live, and an estimated 1,000,000 people watch it at their houses. And as usual yesterday 500,000 people came to watch the race, unfortunately they'd also be a part of the worst racing crash in Wessern history. As the racers started the 4th lap of the Wessern 500, number 47, in first place, driven by council member, and race fanatic Jack Frantoil, suddenly flipped over, and flew into the stand, where five other council members were seated, Jack had instantly died, 3 council members in the stands were killed, and 2 were hospitalized. Another 15 people in the stands died, also the explosion sent debris on to the track causing 1 driver to die, and 4 to be hospitalized, thus bringing the total amount of dead to 20. The one driver that died was Kolionian, Hali Fretnioa, and international racing legend winning 5 races in the last two years. Later that day inside the capital building, during several important meetings, a bomb exploded on the fourth floor, causing the tall building to collapse. of the 400 or so government officials inside, 138 died, as well as 2 people outside, and 5 fire fighters. the disaster caused a complete shut down of down town Wessernia to be shut down for two hours. A total of 145 people died in and around the capital building. Tony Messiaon has been hospitalized, and the entirety of Western View is on lock down, and there was a minute of silence for all the lives lost that day. The WVIB (Western View Investigation Bureau) has already concluded that these were both bombs, and they were the work of Hatzur Zatsugi, leader of the Guhui'Benardio. Security cameras showed him and his associates at both scenes before the disaster happened, always stoping to place something somewhere before leaving.[/spoiler]
